title: farmoytiy sanama yaabuke mara garayte
intro: waktit diini hoxeh suge, farmoyti ugteh seeco luk yadaarem baadal tan Rabbih qibaadah. Tama ximmo, dirab degelti qibaadah addat culteh tan ummattah fanat, ken nummah Gine kee ken abbobtih Rabbi keenih kassiisak, diggalsimak sugte. Uxih ummatta hangisso sinnim kee maabitina cinteh, sinni sarrimaane alfimteh. iyyak sugteeh tah axaxo sinni seeco abe?
clues: Anu inki numma le rabbih gitak yewqeh yan mara fan ruube.
Anu inni ummattal essereeh, Yallak ma meesitaanaa?
Anu Baal deqsita dirab rabbih qibaadah caboonuh keenih seece.
Yi ummatta yi seeco cinteh sinni asnaamah qibaadah garuq luk sugte.
Ken ganak sabbatah oson digga luk digaalah baahe lon.
Yi Rabbi salaam kee barkat le kassit yoh yeceeh ciggiila horaarih fanat.
verse: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers, (37:123)
